title: J. Crew brings its signature approach to styling to life with Claude
summary: J.Crew's Style Advisor, an AI stylist on JCrew.com, is now live for U.S. women's and men's styles and helps shoppers buy complete outfits. Shoppers can describe an occasion or start from one item and receive full looks drawn from J.Crew photo shoots, refinable by chat. Built with Claude Code, it uses a frontier model for planning, Sonnet for styling decisions, and Haiku for quick tasks to bring in-store styling expertise online.

title: Introducing Claude Meetings
summary: Claude Meetings is in beta and lets Claude join Google Meet video calls as a visible participant that follows the conversation and answers questions aloud or in chat. With permission, it can use tools and build docs or whiteboards live, and it writes notes and action items to a claude.ai page with the transcript and artifacts. It is available on Team and Enterprise plans, stays out of calls with outside guests unless an admin allows it, and excludes ZDR, HIPAA-ready, and customer-managed key orgs during beta.

title: Using Claude Opus 5.5 as your daily driver for knowledge work
summary: Opus 5.5 is now the default model on Pro, Max, Ultra, and Team plans, and a guide recommends it for research, analysis, memos, reports, spreadsheets, and decks. Although its per-token price is higher, fewer back-and-forths can offset the cost; an internal test produced a merger model and deck in 63 minutes versus 93 minutes for Opus 5, at about half the cost. Tips include starting at Medium effort, asking for finished files, defining what done means, and skipping "think hard" because thinking is always on.

title: How Curative is building a national provider network with agents on Claude
summary: Health insurer Curative built a hierarchy of agents on Claude, with core agent Gwen handling provider deals from outreach to signature. Contracts are signed about 50x faster than in 2025, with over 23,000 signed at roughly 2,000 to 2,400 per week, and claims dispute responses dropped from about 90 days to under 30 minutes. Lessons include starting with limited agent authority, meeting providers on their preferred channels (adding fax more than doubled win rate), and using a judge agent to audit outbound messages.

title: Operate Claude Managed Agents inside your security perimeter
summary: Self-hosted Claude Managed Agents has entered private beta, extending self-hosting beyond sandboxes to the harness, sandboxes, credentials, and session history, which can all run in your cloud or on-prem. Model routing can go to Anthropic, Bedrock, Google Agent Platform, Microsoft Foundry, or your own gateway, and session history stays in your database (ZDR applies if your org has it). Security features include separating code from the agent loop and secrets, allowlisted network hosts, and OpenTelemetry export.

title: Your apps can now open in Claude, and Claude can work in them
summary: Partner apps can now open inside Claude beside chat or full screen, built on the open MCP Apps extension, and Claude can edit open pages, rows, and files with user approval for actions. It is rolling out on web and desktop to all plans, starting with Asana, Canva, and Notion, and admins can restrict connector tools as they do today. Developers can also run full apps inside Claude in public preview.
